competitiveTarget: Beat Coldwell Banker / Windermere city pages — live neighborhood-level market data no competitor surfaces, plus the in-boundary listing map (EXECUTION_PLAN §8 rank 1).
note: Wave 3 rebuild has LANDED. app/cities/[slug]/page.tsx now imports the Wave 2 site-v2 blocks below (zero components/city/* or components/geo-page/* legacy imports remain). The baseline is CLEARED — the gate now enforces the city page's real block set, so dropping any required block fails G6. SiteHeader/SiteFooter render from app/layout.tsx (not the route file) and are documented under layoutComponents, not requiredComponents (the gate checks the route file's imports).

requiredComponents.name: HeroBlock
requiredComponents.section: hero — 'Homes for sale in {City}, Oregon' + lede + canonical Old Mill photo + Ken Burns (D28/D35)

requiredComponents.name: MarketSnapshot
requiredComponents.section: '{City} housing market' — live SFR stat cards from getMarketStats('city', slug) + getMarketPulse (active count, median list, median DOM, months of supply)

requiredComponents.name: FeaturedListings
requiredComponents.section: 'Featured homes in {City}' — premium active inventory slider for the city (getListings, price-desc). Real homes on every city page, not just stats + links.

requiredComponents.name: PriceChart
requiredComponents.section: 'Price trend' — verified monthly median SALE price (getPriceHistory -> market_stats_cache, SFR-only). Completed months only (drops the in-progress month), linear + per-month dots (no smoothing), data-range y-axis. Renders only where the series is >= 6 complete months; thin sub-city geos are omitted. D98.

requiredComponents.name: PriceRangeTiles
requiredComponents.section: 'Browse {City} homes by budget' — price-bracket tiles linking to filtered search

requiredComponents.name: OpenHousesGrid

requiredComponents.name: NeighborhoodMap
requiredComponents.section: in-boundary listing map — authoritative city polygon + for-sale pins via getGeoBoundaryMapData (D93/D94)
